about.text: soft white goat's milk cheese made from the milk of hay-fed goats, it receives a light dusting of charcoal.

sources.text: Raw goat's milk log, lightly charcoaled, white mould develops; Greenacres Farm, Golden Cross, East Sussex (cheese.com wrongly says ewe's milk)
